subject: Fiscal Year 2026 Budget Recommendations
overview: The Committee of the Whole met to discuss and compile councilors' individual budget recommendations for Fiscal Year 2026. The committee approved a motion to forward a unified list of eight collective priority areas to the full City Council.

items.title: Resolution 25-039: Fiscal Year 2026 Budget Schedule and Recommendations
items.summary: The committee reviewed councilors' budget recommendations, ultimately approving a motion to compile eight collective priorities—including funding for recreation positions, a competitive city solicitor salary, a fire department dive team, and assessing department capacity for a residential exemption—into a unified memo alongside individual requests.
